transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Doctor. For years now I’ve felt this constant heaviness and sadness that never really lifts, even when things in my life are going okay. It just feels like I'm carrying this weight around all the time, and I finally realized I need some help.
Has this low mood been present consistently for at least two years, or have there been distinct periods where you felt completely back to your normal self?

It has been very consistent, lasting for a little over three years now, starting around the time my husband and I separated. I haven't had any real breaks or periods where I felt back to my normal self; it has just been a steady, heavy presence that never really lifts.
During these past three years, have you experienced other symptoms like changes in your appetite, difficulty sleeping, low energy, or feelings of low self-esteem?

I'm not really sure about my appetite, but my sleep is terrible; I lie in bed exhausted but wired, and then wake up at three in the morning with my mind spinning about my divorce. I also have almost no energy to socialize anymore, and I'm constantly plagued by low self-esteem, feeling like a complete failure because my marriage ended.
Have you ever experienced a period of two weeks or more where your mood was significantly lower than your current baseline, accompanied by a total loss of interest in almost all activities?

No, I haven't really experienced a distinct period where my mood dropped significantly lower than this baseline. It has just been a steady, constant heaviness and lack of interest that has persisted at pretty much this same level for the last three years.
During these past three years, have you ever experienced any periods where you felt unusually energized, overly happy, or needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I've never had any periods like that where I felt unusually high or energized. My mood has just remained consistently heavy and low this entire time.
During these past three years, have you frequently found it difficult to concentrate on tasks or struggled to make simple daily decisions?

Yes, that has been a major struggle for me over the last three years, as my brain constantly feels slow and foggy. At work, I find myself rereading the same spreadsheet cells over and over and losing my train of thought mid-sentence during meetings. I also agonize for ridiculous amounts of time over simple decisions, like which client email to answer first.
